description: This PHP class 'TranslationCollection' serves as a data transfer object (DTO) within the i18n module of the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates collections of translation data, including mappings from keys to source/target translations, keys to target translations, and source to target translations.

classes.name: TranslationCollection
classes.description: A data transfer object for holding various translation mappings used in internationalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the translation collection with three types of translation maps.

methods.name: getKeyAndSourceTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to their source and target sources.

methods.name: getKeyAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of translation keys to their target translations.

methods.name: getSourceAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the mapping of source strings to target translations.
